caption: "ynon kreiz" — 500+ searches today. The man behind the Barbie movie is joining Hollywood's biggest merger.

Why: On September 30, Paramount named Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of the company it forms by buying Warner Bros. Discovery, a $110 billion deal. He starts October 5 and runs day-to-day operations. David Ellison keeps strategy. The news came minutes after a judge cleared the merger.

What most people don't know: Barbie, Mattel's first movie, became Warner Bros. Pictures' biggest film ever, at over $1.4 billion. Yet Mattel's stock rose just 5% in Kreiz's 8 years as CEO, while the S&P 500 gained nearly 200%, Reuters reports.
Very simply put: Barbie won the box office. Mattel's stock barely noticed.
